title: VPN & Proxy Policy Template - Secure Usage Guidelines
metaDescription: Professional VPN and proxy policy template for organizations. Establish clear guidelines for secure VPN usage and protect your network.
description: A comprehensive policy template for organizations to establish clear guidelines for VPN and proxy usage. Covers security requirements, acceptable use, logging practices, and compliance standards to protect corporate networks and data.

sections.heading: Policy Overview and Purpose
sections.content: This policy establishes guidelines for the use of Virtual Private Networks (VPNs) and proxy services within {{organization_name}}. The purpose is to ensure secure, authorized access to corporate resources while maintaining network integrity and data protection. This policy applies to all employees, contractors, and third parties accessing company systems remotely.

sections.heading: Authorized VPN and Proxy Services
sections.content: Only approved VPN solutions may be used for accessing corporate resources. The following criteria must be met: enterprise-grade encryption (AES-256), verified no-log policies, company-vetted providers, and centralized management capabilities. Personal or free VPN services are prohibited for business use due to security risks. Approved services include {{approved_vpn_list}}. Use of Incognito Browser is recommended for additional privacy protection during VPN sessions.

sections.heading: Security Requirements and Configuration
sections.content: All VPN connections must use strong authentication methods including multi-factor authentication (MFA) where available. Employees must ensure VPN clients are updated to the latest version and configured with kill switches enabled. Split tunneling is {{split_tunneling_policy}} unless specifically authorized. DNS leak protection must be activated. Regular security audits will verify compliance with these requirements.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use Guidelines
sections.content: VPN and proxy services may only be used for legitimate business purposes including secure remote access, protecting data on public WiFi, and accessing geo-restricted business resources. Prohibited activities include circumventing corporate security policies, accessing inappropriate content, torrenting or file sharing, and using VPNs to mask unauthorized activities. Personal use is {{personal_use_policy}} during business hours.

sections.heading: Logging and Monitoring Practices
sections.content: {{organization_name}} maintains logs of VPN connection attempts, session durations, and data transfer volumes for security monitoring. Personal browsing activities are not monitored when using approved VPN services. Logs are retained for {{log_retention_period}} and are only accessed for security investigations or compliance audits. Employees will be notified of any monitoring that may affect personal privacy.

sections.heading: Incident Reporting and Compliance
sections.content: Any suspected VPN security incidents, including connection failures, potential breaches, or unauthorized access attempts, must be reported immediately to {{security_contact}}. Regular compliance reviews will assess adherence to this policy. Violations may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination. Training on secure VPN usage will be provided annually to all employees.

useCases: Corporate IT departments establishing VPN usage policies
Remote work organizations securing employee connections
Companies with BYOD policies requiring VPN guidelines
Organizations needing compliance with data protection regulations
Businesses protecting intellectual property through secure access
